submissions.title: LA County Bans New Mega Data Centers Temporarily
submissions.excerpt: a temporary ban that officials say will hold until a permanent ordinance is written, vetted, and brought before the Board of Supervisors
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Los Angeles County Department of Regional Planning (Director Amy Bodek) issued a moratorium on new hyperscale data centers across all unincorporated county zones, effective 2026-09-17, announced by Board Chair Hilda Solis.
